title: Trade Mining & Referrals
subtitle: Provide telemetry and earn $DEPTH tokens on every trade
miningHeroDesc: Your node converts verified exchange volume into DEPTH emissions. Referrals compound your share of every epoch.
activationDescription: By activating Trade Mining, you agree to share your closed trades (symbol, entry/exit prices, volume, PnL, duration, order IDs) and strategy parameters with the Central Hub, linked to your node's wallet address and exchange UID, to earn $DEPTH rewards. Your exchange API keys, passwords and asset balances are never shared.
welcomeBonusDesc: Generate at least $1.0 of cumulative rebate to claim your welcome bonus.
stakingBoostDesc: Lock $DEPTH to multiply your mining earnings.
nodeSharingPolicyDesc: Rewards are distributed in real-time according to verified trade volume share and active node policy.
welcomeBonusClaimedDesc: 1000 $DEPTH has been credited to your node balance.
referralProgramDesc: Invite friends to run nodes and earn a +10% daily boost plus matching welcome rewards!
stakingBoostDetail: Stake $DEPTH for 30, 90 or 360 days to unlock up to 2.0x multiplier on all daily trade mining emission awards.
supportedExchangesDesc: Trade mining rewards are calculated for live trades executed on the following exchanges:
supportedExchangesRebateNote: Rewards are directly tied to the fee rebate generated: the higher the exchange rebate rate, the higher your $DEPTH reward accordingly. The Central Hub securely verifies every trade directly via the exchanges' broker APIs.
totalInvitedSubtitle: Nodes joined using your ref link
referralListDesc: Track your referrals, trading volumes, and 10% bonus earnings in real-time.

noReferralsYet: No invited nodes or users yet
noReferralsDesc: Share your referral link or node deploy command to invite friends and earn 10% of their daily mining rewards forever!
referrerCodeDetected: Referral code detected from registration link.
tradesDesc: Inspect trade reports, exchange verification status, and daily mining rewards.
noTradesDesc: Trades will automatically appear here as trading bots execute orders.
miningActivated: Trade mining successfully activated! Your exchange UID has been resolved and linked automatically.
miningDeactivated: Trade mining successfully disabled. Telemetry will not be sent.
reasonNotEligibleDefault: Failed quality gate (min hold time / min price movement)

walletSubtitle: Connect your EVM wallet (MetaMask / Web3) to secure your mining rewards and node identity.
walletNoticeEVM: Your private key never leaves your wallet. Server verifies ownership via cryptographically signed message. Rewards and node migration remain 100% under your control.
referrerCodeHint: Binds your node to the inviter so referral mining rewards flow. Can only be set at wallet bind time.

userRejectedSignature: Signature request was rejected in wallet.
manualEpochDesc: Verify PENDING trades and distribute $DEPTH token rewards for the selected epoch immediately.
epochDateHint: Only completed past days can be processed. Late PENDING trades from a finalized epoch are verified and credited to the next epoch.
epochProcessedDesc: Mining epoch processed successfully. Rewards distributed.
epochProcessingFailedDesc: An error occurred while processing the mining epoch.
rebateRateTooltipOkx: Base broker rate from clean accounts is 30%; if the account is under a referral, it is 7.5%.
rebateRateTooltipBybit: Base broker rate from clean accounts is 50%; if the account is under a referral, it is 10%.
rebateRateTooltipBitget: Base broker rate from clean accounts is 35%; if the account is under a referral, it is 8%. Active 2.0x Mining Multiplier earns 2x $DEPTH token yield per USDT rebate.
rebateRateTooltipDefault: Base broker rebate rate. Mining rewards are distributed proportionally to verified trading volume and fees.
qualityGateOperatorDescAnd: Trade must meet BOTH duration and price movement
qualityGateOperatorDescOr: Trade qualifies if EITHER duration OR price movement is met
promotionalBoostDesc: Trade on partner exchanges (e.g. Bitget) to earn boosted $DEPTH token rewards per dollar of rebate. Direct your liquidity to maximize farming yields!
exchangeMultipliersDesc: Configure trade mining reward multipliers per exchange (e.g., 2.0x for Bitget) to steer user volume. Weights points in daily pool; daily emission remains fixed without inflation.
promoQuestsDescription: Complete quests to earn $DEPTH tokens from the 10M promotional airdrop pool. Each quest is granted once per unique Bitget master account UID.
promoBannerSubtitle: Connect Bitget API keys & trade to earn up to 25,000 $DEPTH per quest.
sidebarMiningClickHub: Click to open Trade Mining Hub →
